about: Laws that set federal corporate income taxes, shown under "The laws that set these taxes" on /taxes/companies/ and every company's page (functions/_lib/taxes.js). Hand-kept: each entry's titles, public law, date and description are copied word for word from Congress.gov (checked 2026-11-11 through Congress.gov's API: the accuracy audit's section 8, tools/accuracy_audit.py). The sync's law-votes step loads every recorded vote on each bill (workers/sync/src/history/sync.js). Add a law only from official sources.
note: Names are Congress.gov's popular titles; official titles, public law numbers and summaries from Congress.gov.

laws.name: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act
laws.official_title: An act to provide for reconciliation pursuant to titles II and V of the concurrent resolution on the budget for fiscal year 2018.
laws.description: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code (IRC) to reduce tax rates and modify policies, credits, and deductions for individuals and businesses.

final_votes.action: On motion that the House agree to the Senate amendment Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: 224 - 201 (Roll no. 699).
Senate receded from its amendment and concurred with an amendment (SA 1863) by Yea-Nay Vote. 51 - 48. Record Vote Number: 323.

laws.name: Inflation Reduction Act of 2022
laws.official_title: An act to provide for reconciliation pursuant to title II of S. Con. Res. 14.
laws.description: This act imposes an alternative minimum tax of 15% of the average annual adjusted financial statement income of domestic corporations (excluding Subchapter S corporations, regulated investment companies, and real estate investment trusts) that exceeds $1 billion over a specified 3-year period.

final_votes.action: Passed Senate with an amendment by Yea-Nay Vote. 51 - 50. Record Vote Number: 325.
On motion that the House agree to the Senate amendment Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: 220 - 207 (Roll no. 420).

laws.name: One Big Beautiful Bill Act
laws.official_title: An act to provide for reconciliation pursuant to title II of H. Con. Res. 14.
laws.description: This act reduces taxes, reduces or increases spending for various federal programs, increases the statutory debt limit, and otherwise addresses agencies and programs throughout the federal government.
